fix_commit_full: fix: BUG-003 P2 - dashboard Companies KPI counted archived companies (18 vs real 8)
fix_applied: web/app/(app)/dashboard/page.tsx now applies .neq("status","archived") on the companies count query, matching getCompanies()'s own definition byte-for-byte. Label changed to "Active Companies" so the figure is self-describing, not just self-consistent.
verification_evidence: Independent verifier re-ran a fresh, independently-written live query against production (not the implementer's own script) and got total_companies=18, non_archived_count=8, archived_count=10 — matching BUG-003's originally-reported split exactly, confirming the dashboard and /companies now agree.
note_this_session: Dashboard was also later extended (2026-09-01, part of the multi-org milestone, unrelated to this bug) to scope its goal/approval/run counts by active organization when one is selected — Active Companies itself stays a global platform figure by design, not re-scoped by org, since it isn't something a single org's context can meaningfully redefine.
